verdict.rationale: The Nitrokey 3 firmware repository says it is fully open source and dual licensed under Apache 2.0 and MIT. A runtime probe confirms the Rust source has tagged, installable releases. One community report notes that the Nitrokey HSM's internal applet is not free/open source, so openness does not cover every product line. Missing for 10: open-source coverage of the Nitrokey HSM applet, and evidenced license terms for other components such as nitropy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: This software is fully open source.
All software, unless otherwise noted, is dual licensed under Apache 2.0 and MIT license.
Nitrokey 3 firmware is open source in Rust WITH tagged, installable releases
